chat.sourceContentDiffers: The source text or role differs between observations.
chat.sessionOrder: Ordered by proven session message sequence
chat.windowOrder: Order applies only within this history window

egress.title: Credentials and egress trust
egress.setupTitle: Use the model key for a protected target
egress.setupNote: Choose an actual configured target and route, bind the key saved above, then issue a reusable phantom key below. No IDs or JSON are needed.
egress.setupMissingTarget: No concrete target or route is configured yet. Check appliance startup or manage egress in Settings.
egress.setupImportFirst: Save your own model key above first.
egress.setupBound: The binding is saved. See the actual adoption receipt, then request a phantom key below.
egress.intro: Review configured destinations and credential scopes.
egress.modeNote: Saved configuration and runtime state are separate facts. Neither proves that an application or container trusts the CA.
egress.invalidConfig: The credential or egress configuration shape could not be verified. Read settings again.
egress.ensureNote: Reuse the service's persistent CA if it exists; create one only on first use. This does not change configuration or install trust.
egress.trustNote: Install the public certificate at the actual deployment target. Host, Docker and Node trust have not been verified here.
egress.caBound: This certificate matches the CA ID in the current configuration read. Trust at the deployment target is unverified.
egress.caHistorical: Historical certificate information received on this connection; not bound to the current configuration. Explicitly read the public CA once configuration is stable.
egress.downloadFailed: The certificate download did not complete. Try the action again.
egress.bindingsNote: See which processes or containers can use each destination, method and path.
egress.noBindings: No saved bindings. Create a binding in settings.
egress.routeMissing: The referenced route is missing from configuration
egress.secretNote: Input goes only to the authenticated local service and is cleared on submission. Empty values, CR/LF/NUL and values over 16,384 UTF-8 bytes are rejected. Whitespace is preserved. JavaScript cannot guarantee memory zeroization.
egress.rotate: Replace using the original reference and revision
egress.secretConfirm: Save the input without adding it to configuration. Success returns only a non-secret reference and revision. Replacement uses the exact original revision supplied.
egress.invalidSecret: The value is empty, contains a forbidden character or exceeds 16,384 UTF-8 bytes. Enter it again.
egress.invalidReference: Use a 32-digit hexadecimal ID and the original unsigned 64-bit decimal revision.
egress.issueNote: Select an enabled binding from the configuration just read. Actual subjects and destinations are still checked on every request.
egress.noEnabledBindings: No enabled binding is eligible for issuance. Check subjects and routes in settings.
egress.issueConfirm: Issue for these subjects, destinations, authentication slot and configuration version. The returned value cannot be read again.
egress.onceNote: This key is reusable until you rotate or revoke it. Leaving, locking, starting another action or closing only clears this display; it does not revoke the key. Save the returned value.
egress.copyFailed: Copy did not complete. You can reveal the value and copy it manually.
egress.revokeNote: Enter the non-secret token ID, not the phantom value.
egress.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token ID. This does not establish that already-started requests were withdrawn.
egress.receiptsNote: Keep references, token IDs and revisions for future rotation or revocation.
egress.noReceipts: No receipts in this session yet.
egress.pending: Waiting for the receipt. No automatic resend.
egress.operationFailed: The service returned a failure code. This alone does not establish a rollback of persisted data.
egress.unconfirmed: The outcome is uncertain. Data or issuance may have persisted. Failure or rollback is not assumed, and the operation will not be automatically resent.
egress.permissionRevoked: Credential-management permission was withdrawn. Lock and authenticate again to continue.
egress.noManagementPermission: Managing CA certificates, provider secrets and Phantom tokens requires service management permission.

rules.sendFailed: The send result is unconfirmed. A save cannot be ruled out. Read again to check.

processes.title: Processes and containers
processes.subtitle: View observed processes and where they belong.
group.title: Group
group.scope: Observed caller → callee. Lines show calls, not OS parentage or confirmed Agent identities.
group.coverage: Configured plaintext A2A, direct OTLP/HTTP and Gateway WebSocket on IPv4 loopback in the host's initial network namespace, plus verified Flow exchanges. Gateway records cover only messages actually published to observed clients. This reply does not guarantee collection readiness or completeness.
group.unidentified: Product, brand and Agent identity are unidentified.
group.noGrant: Chat content permission on this connection is required. Management access does not replace it; no query is sent without permission.
group.initial: Call observations have not been read yet.
group.readFailed: Could not read delegations. Check the original failure below. No automatic retry.
group.wrongReply: The delegation reply type or exclusive page boundary does not match the request. Read again from the first page.
group.sendFailed: The delegation query could not be sent. It will not be resent automatically.
group.pageCount: Page {page} in this read sequence · {records} records
group.empty: This query returned no delegation records. This does not mean there are no Agents.
group.morePages: Earlier records are available. The next page replaces this page.
group.lastPage: There are no earlier pages in this traversal.
processes.pageSizeHelp: Choose fewer rows and reload from the first page.
processes.rawFilterNote: The service matches retained original values. Older observations do not confirm current membership.

processes.outputFailed: The service could not send its reply. Choose a smaller page if needed and reload from the first page.
processes.cursorExpired: The list changed. Reload from the first page.
processes.buildingNote: The initial inventory has not been verified yet.
processes.readyNote: The current enumeration and stream barrier were verified. This does not establish complete or live fields, or enabled protection.
processes.uncertainNote: A source gap or resource failure is known. Returned records do not form a complete current inventory.
processes.closedNote: The tree accepts no new work. Returned records only describe information retained at read time.
processes.historicalGap: Historical collection has a gap. A later successful read does not recover that history.
processes.pageCount: Page {page} in this read sequence · {count} records returned
processes.pageChanged: Inventory state changed since the previous page. These pages do not form a single point-in-time snapshot.
processes.containerScope: Container memberships confirmed from processes on this page.
processes.noContainers: No confirmed container membership was observed on this page.
processes.hostGroup: Confirmed host membership on this page

processes.creator: Actual creator (separate from parent)
processes.originalRecord: Show history and all original fields
processes.known: Confirmed observation in this evidence generation
processes.oldEpoch: Observation from an older evidence generation · current value unconfirmed
processes.observationSource: Source: {source} · evidence generation {epoch} · {begin}–{end} ns since boot

activity.empty: No committed records on this page.

activity.wrongReply: The log reply type or exclusive page boundary does not match the request.
activity.outputFailed: The original log reply could not be output. Check the diagnostic code.
activity.sendFailed: Could not send the security log request. Read again explicitly to retry.
activity.closeNote: A close notification for a file opened for writing. It does not prove a write or successful persistence.
activity.intentRead: Read this event’s evidence to see linked messages and tool calls.
activity.intentUnlinked: The available evidence does not link a model call to this operation.
activity.intentNoUser: No user message from this model request was available.

activity.inspectChain: View behavior chain and source records
activity.page: Current page {page} · descending row order in this log database
evidence.title: Event evidence
evidence.noAnchor: This record has no original EventKey. Paths, inodes and TIDs are not used to infer evidence links.
evidence.noGrant: Reading event evidence requires chat content permission on this connection, independently of security log management permission.
evidence.loading: Reading evidence for the selected original event…
evidence.notFound: The requested evidence was not found. This does not establish that it was not retained or has expired.
evidence.wrongReply: The evidence reply type or original EventKey does not match the request.
evidence.sendFailed: Could not send the evidence request. It will not be resent automatically.
evidence.question: Actually received question
evidence.returnNote: The actual return value, including an original negative error. It is separate from a rule proposal or checkpoint decision.
evidence.waitUnpaired: The wait is unpaired. A selection alone does not confirm tool execution or a call relationship.
evidence.waitPaired: The original wait queue entry and thread are paired. This alone does not establish a tool execution relationship.
evidence.unitsNote: BOOTTIME values are nanoseconds since boot. Original identifiers, enums and gap reasons are preserved.
evidence.noSources: No source records in this reply. This does not imply complete evidence.
evidence.relationsNote: Only relationships returned with explicit evidence are shown. References are not queried automatically.
evidence.noRelations: This reply contains no evidence relationships.
evidence.noGaps: No gap reasons were attached to this reply. This does not guarantee completeness.
evidence.gapReference: Expand the original reference for this gap
evidence.agentBindingUnavailable: Agent association could not be verified.
evidence.commandMappingUnavailable: The command input mapping is missing.
evidence.notProvided: The source did not supply this record.
evidence.notRetained: The record is no longer retained.
evidence.downloadNote: The snapshot contains evidence for the current event and may include captured content.
evidence.downloadFailed: Event evidence could not be downloaded. Check that evidence for the current event has been read, then try again.

ask.noConfirmedChat: No conversation was confirmed for this operation.
ask.unconfirmedUpstream: No upstream tool call is confirmed.
ask.loading: Reading evidence for this review… The original deadline and answer state are unchanged.
ask.noGrant: This connection has no chat content permission. Answer permission and the original time limit are checked separately.
ask.wrongReply: The query ID, review ID, original event or business reply type did not match. This evidence was not displayed.
ask.noBridge: This reply does not confirm a link between a tool call and the original operation. Only source types and evidence gaps are listed below.
ask.confirmed: Confirmed: tool call and this operation
ask.nativeNote: These are native facts for the original event, independent of a confirmed HTTP tool call link.
evidence.cancelNote: Only stops this browser's wait for the reply. It does not cancel server-side SQL.

chain.resultObservationsNote: These observations share the same original tool-call reference, result identifier, acquisition domain, and complete content. Each original reference remains available; this does not confirm ownership of the system operation.
chain.toolResultNote: The original tool report is shown independently. It does not establish a syscall return or confirmed operation causality.
chain.containerCandidate: Earlier tool call in the same container · candidate relationship
chain.sameOperation: Receipt for the same original operation
chain.evidenceMismatch: The evidence anchor does not match this operation. Expand the original records to inspect them.
chain.projectionLimit: This link is unverified. Available originals and candidates are shown separately.
settings.title: Settings and diagnostics
settings.intro: Inspect saved service settings, actual runtime status and operation receipts.
settings.noWritePermission: This connection can view settings. Saving, reloading and temporary controls require service management permission.
settings.readComplete: Current saved settings have been read.
settings.readFailed: Current settings could not be confirmed. Read them again.
settings.readSendFailed: The settings query could not be sent. Read them again.
settings.lastRead: These are the previously read values. Current settings are unconfirmed.
settings.defaultsNote: These are saved defaults, separate from the driver's current state and temporary overrides.
settings.selfLogNote: Changes log requests only. It does not disable self-protection or remove access restrictions.
settings.advancedNote: Edit the complete non-secret configuration and retain untouched content. group_observation is required: null or an object explicitly containing a2a_port, otlp_http_port and gateway_ws_port. Each port is null (source disabled) or an integer from 1 to 65535; enable at least one source and use distinct enabled ports. Duplicate keys, unknown top-level fields and invalid basic structures are rejected. The service still validates business rules.
settings.discardAdvanced: Discard advanced changes and return to the form
settings.invalidDocument: This is not a complete current configuration. Check duplicate JSON keys, required fields, types and format version 2. group_observation must be null or contain two distinct integer ports from 1 to 65535.
settings.saveNote: Save the complete document against this version. Persistence and runtime adoption are confirmed separately.
settings.proposedDocument: Expand the complete document to be sent
settings.accessWarning: Access changes can revoke this connection. Verify the new endpoint, Origin, permissions and authentication method before continuing. After disconnection, authenticate again and read settings; do not assume a save or rollback.
settings.accessAcknowledgement: I have verified how to connect after this change
settings.reloadSections: Changed sections are unknown until the fixed file is read again. This request uses the current version as its precondition.
settings.reloadNote: The service reads the same fixed file. The browser does not open a file or choose a path. Existing temporary overrides are retained.
settings.writing: Operation sent · waiting for the final receipt…
settings.failed: The operation returned a failure. Confirmed facts are retained below.
settings.unconfirmed: The final operation status is unconfirmed. It will not be replayed automatically. Authenticate again or read current state to verify it.
settings.savedPending: Configuration is saved. Required adoption is pending or unconfirmed.
settings.reloaded: Configuration was read again from the fixed file.
settings.sourceRead: The receipt contains configuration actually read from the source. Runtime adoption remains unconfirmed.
settings.noEffects: This save requires no additional effects.
settings.effectReconnect: Authenticate again and read current settings
settings.effectCompleted: Adoption confirmed by this completed command
settings.driverReceipt: An actual driver receipt was returned. Inspect its state and projection version.
settings.driverUnconfirmed: This receipt does not confirm driver adoption.
settings.versionNote: The driver projection version is not the complete configuration version. Saving does not mean every setting is active.
settings.conflict: Configuration version conflict. The old draft was discarded. Check the newly read settings, then edit and confirm again.
settings.runtimeNote: Uses the same latest receipt as protection overview. Temporary controls are not saved, and ordinary reloads retain overrides.
settings.partialStatus: These are actual status facts attached to an incomplete or failed command.
settings.controlNote: Changes only this protection category's temporary state. No configuration is saved. The overview refreshes after an actual final receipt.
settings.resumeNote: Removes the override and uses the driver's current default. If the default is disabled, protection remains disabled.
settings.controlCompleted: Temporary control completed and an actual driver receipt was returned.
group.noStageGap: No gap reported in these checks
group.openReceiptExchange: Open this HTTP exchange in chat history
group.receiptExchangeScope: Opens the HTTP exchange containing the acceptance receipt, without locating a specific message or tool position.
processes.getNote: Queries only the original complete process key. No list search or same-PID substitution.
processes.getDetailNote: This record and evidence epoch come from the exact Get reply. Current or last observations do not rewrite the historical call.
processes.instanceNotFound: The original process instance was not found. This does not prove it exited or identify a successor.
processes.wrongInstance: The returned complete process key does not match the requested instance. The record is not selected.
processes.lookupDetails: Complete Get details, parent projections and child count
chat.sessionFiltered: Showing exchanges for the selected session
chat.sessionUnavailable: This field has a capture issue and cannot be used to filter.

chat.scope: Browse retained HTTP exchanges and their original messages. Request context may repeat earlier content; an exchange is not a Session.
chat.identityGap: Sessions are grouped by their observed field and source. Agent identity requires separate evidence.

chat.sendFailed: The chat query could not be sent. No automatic retry.

chat.emptyExchanges: No retained exchanges were returned by this query.
